answer: A newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it, locking 93 POA that is slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. The hollow of the register names the voucher for every alias, so a farm's whole sponsor ladder is visible at once; the mirror of a conviction climbs the chain, and the pearl of slashed bonds pays the auditors who caught it. No honest sponsor risks real money on a stranger, so 610 fakes need 610 bought sponsors.
